races.title: State Senate, District 6
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Michael Anthony Lazzara
cands.bio: Republican state senator for North Carolina Senate District 6 (Onslow County) since January 2021. Marine Corps veteran (1982–86), small business owner (pizza restaurants, Vital Signs), Jacksonville City Council member from 2005 until 2020, and past president of the NC League of Municipalities.
cands.gaps: We found no documented statements from Lazzara on data centers, homestead property tax elimination, limits on out-of-state, investor or foreign land buyers, or growth and land conservation limits. We found nothing on H-1B visas, E-Verify or immigration enforcement, or on Second Amendment issues such as red-flag laws, suppressors or purchase ages. We found no specific bills he sponsored (the sponsored-legislation list on his profile was empty) and no news coverage describing particular actions in office. His campaign site gives general priorities only, such as keeping taxes low and supporting school choice, with no detailed plans. We found no news reporting of controversies and no listed endorsements for 2026. Exact birth date and year of birth were not found.

local.label: Roots 55: He was born in Sicily and raised in Chicago, came to Camp Lejeune in 1982, and has lived in Jacksonville since 1986, about 40 years, building a business and a political career there.

qual.background: State senator since 2021; Jacksonville City Council member 2005–2020, many years as Mayor Pro Tem; past president of the NC League of Municipalities; founder and owner of local businesses; Marine Corps veteran.
qual.why: He has more than five years of prior legislative service in the Senate, about 15 years in local elected office, and over 30 years as a business owner and manager. His 2020 survey also cites experience building budgets. Committee chair roles were not counted.

school-choice-teachers.evidence: His campaign site says he supports strengthening teacher recruitment and retention and giving families greater freedom to choose the educational setting that best meets their child's needs. It names no specific voucher program or teacher raise.

pro-life.evidence: His campaign site says he will continue defending the sanctity of life.

back-police-order.evidence: His campaign site says he will continue supporting law enforcement and strengthening penalties for violent offenders and drug traffickers. It names no specific pay or pension proposal.

cands.name: Andi Morrow
cands.bio: Andi Morrow is a Democrat and small-business owner who runs a cleaning business in a small coastal eastern North Carolina town. Morrow earned degrees from East Carolina University in 2017 and 2021. Morrow has held no public office and ran for State Senate District 6 in 2024 and 2026.

endorsements.text: Planned Parenthood Votes South Atlantic, listed by Morrow in the 2024 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey as endorsing the campaign.

cands.gaps: We found no stated positions from Andi Morrow on data centers, property taxes, land buying, growth and development, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns, abortion or school choice. Morrow did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey. The 2024 survey answers speak only in general terms of fairness, democracy, economics, education, kindness and a ballot initiative process. We could not establish where Morrow was raised, when Morrow moved to North Carolina, or the name of the home town. We found no news coverage, controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements beyond those listed. Morrow has held no public office, so there is no record of official actions.
